text:
alex: Quick heads-up — going to cut a tiny patch to 2.3.10 for the kvcache OOM when seq_len > 8k. Minimal diff, just backport of kvcache-bounds fix. Target cutoff in 20m. Can anyone take smoke after canary?

maria: On it. I'll run the canary on us-west-2-gpupool at +10. Will post logs. Any special smoke steps?

devon: Quick checklist: cherry-pick commit `a1b2c3d` to `release/2.3.x`; build + push image `redwood/inference:2.3.10-hotfix`; run `devops/smoke.sh` (see repo/devops/smoke.sh). I'll cut the canary.

alex: Thanks. smoke steps: 1) start canary 5 instances, 2) run prompt-regress suite (~30s), 3) verify KV cache mem stays steady, 4) latency within 5% of baseline.

sam: FYI, I've queued CI pipeline; `pipeline/2.3-hotfix` shows green. I'll monitor logs. If canary looks good, we can roll to 50% traffic and then full.

release-bot: Deploy started: canary -> us-west-2-gpupool (5 nodes). Run ID: deploy-1773700012. Status: in-progress.

maria: Canary logs look clean so far. memory usage flat. One 500 in model-proxy at +2m but recovered. putting notes in PR.

devon: If canary clear at +10m, I'll open the cutoff tag. Who can sanity approve the changelog blurb? Need one-liner.

alex: I'll write changelog: "Fix kvcache OOM on long-context inference; backport bounds check." Ping me for grammar.

sam: Approving changelog. After 50% ramp, I'll hold 5m then full ramp. @oncall if anything spikes, please ping.

sre-bot: Alert policy: `kvcache_mem > 85% for 3m` triggers page to #eng-oncall. No alerts in last 6m.

alex: Awesome — plan reiterated. Cutoff 20m from now. If no blockers, tagging and release by +25m. :rocket:
